methodology_notes: All 2,254 original entries are preserved; v57 adds a non-destructive intelligence/provenance layer.
SM-2 tiers are review scheduling states, not claims of language competence.
Legacy decomposition/cultural notes are labelled by source status; AI/unknown content is not silently promoted to verified fact.
External verification sources are catalogued separately; source-specific licensing and review remain explicit.
Every entry now carries explicit sourceRefs and a verificationPlan; these are verification targets, not false claims that external fields were bulk-verified.
